message:
The libass fuzzer isn't pre-built. I need to build it. Let me check what tools are available and build libass. First, let me check the dependencies.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>which gcc g++ clang clang++ autoconf automake libtoolize pkg-config 2>/dev/null && echo "---" && pkg-config --exists fontconfig && echo "fontconfig OK" || echo "fontconfig missing" && pkg-config --exists freetype2 && echo "freetype2 OK" || echo "freetype2 missing"</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
